notes.title: Lands of Gimle - Cartographer's Notes #5 - Forests
notes.content:
[h2]👋 Góðan daginn, Travelers!👋 [/h2]

Dense, misty forests are an inseparable element of the landscape of the world of Gimle. Wherever you look, you're sure to see plenty of trees dotting hills, valleys, and other vast expanses of land. Every experienced adventurer knows [b]how fascinating and dangerous the woods can be[/b] 🌲🌳 The forest is a great place to hide from law enforcers, prepare a deadly ambush, hide stolen loot, or simply run away from your problems and start over. This is just a glimpse of what you can find among countless miles covered with [b]trees, bushes, and other, often very intriguing, vegetation[/b]. Come! It's time to dive into the endless forest...

[url=https://discord.gg/8KnCYpm2xT][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41450177/5bd7570ac75752cdf33a3579a783ea3f93dfdc3a.png[/img][/url]
[h3]and talk to the community and developers about the game![/h3]


You can be sure that nearly every inhabitant of Gimle knows the forests surrounding their place of residence. They are so [b]common and so strongly associated with the lives of local folks[/b] that it is difficult to find a person who has never had the opportunity to wander through one of them. Yet... only a tiny fraction of Gimle forests have ever been explored by human travelers... 🗺 Great mysteries are still waiting to be discovered.


[h2]Welcome to the forest[/h2]
[hr][/hr]
Let's start with the fact that the forests surrounding human cities and villages are one of the most important elements of their economy. The wood obtained from the forests is a wonderful, easily accessible, and [b]durable building material[/b] - no wonder that the vast majority of buildings consist of some elements made of this material 🪓 In addition, wood is used to heat homes and administrative buildings, build boats, barrels, carts, tools, weapons, or furniture - and the list goes on! Therefore, you will often meet people who deal with logging and wood processing. 

An equally important economic role of the forest is to [b]provide people with food and herbs[/b]. Experienced gatherers can fill their baskets with berries, mushrooms 🍄 and roots during a single trip to the forest. In addition, there are also hunters who hunt thicket-dwelling prey for their bones, skin, and meat. Herbalists and druids also have their hands full - the forest provides them with [b]ingredients for medicines, infusions, and potions[/b]. Of course, these are not the only ways humans have learned to use the forest for their needs. For now, however, let's focus on a completely different aspect... 


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41450177/918e7805fb290ffdc93d9c5f230f55bc19a0555c.png[/img]


As we mentioned, in the world of Gimle, the forests stretch for miles, often as far as the eye can see. And although forests delight us with their beauty, it should be remembered that[b] they are not the safest places to be around.[/b] 🐺 However, travelers, traders, messengers, and warriors sometimes have to travel through the forest. By exercising general caution, sticking to the right path, and keeping guard at night, they manage to reach their destination... though not always. What gets in their way and [b]ends their journey in a rather drastic way?[/b] And how to travel through the forest to avoid dangers? Luckily, our Cartographer has a handful of useful information for you.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41450177/10dcd5320c20529f6e8b426eb7c92638159b2cc9.png[/img]


[h2]The forest hides much more than you think...[/h2]
[hr][/hr]
One of the dangers waiting for you in the forests of Gimle is all kinds of bandits and outlaws. However, this time we will not speak too much about them, because we recently devoted a whole part of the Know your Enemies series to them (you can find it here 👉 [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1765920?emclan=103582791470971585&emgid=3405310798894444190][b]Bandits & Outlaws[/b][/url]). Suffice it to say that bandit packs roaming the forests are a nuisance to travelers and traders who can lose their gold, goods, and sometimes even their lives if the cutthroat chieftain decides so. 

Instead, let's talk about more natural threats - those coming from the forest dwellers. And there are really a lot of them! Among the most commonly occurring we can list wolves, boars, bears, snakes, or various types of birds known from our reality... but also [b]absolutely fantastic and deadly creatures[/b] such as bloodthirsty wargs, poisonous brunnmigi, stunningly quick calopus, or frightening sabel-tonn ☠️ [b]Who knows what else lurks in the impassable, fog-covered depths of the forest[/b]... Legends speak of even more terrible, magic-twisted creatures. Although many doubt their existence, the oldest sages sometimes mention anguished beings corrupted by the harmful influence of dark magic, which distorts the very essence of nature and drives it to madness. Woe to those who stand in their way...


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41450177/8a84ca50c2b5c9babde2276d128e3ad1d220cde2.png[/img]


During one of your numerous voyages through the forests 🌲 you will surely experience many unusual encounters and come across a bunch of mysterious places. These can be, for example, forgotten shrines and abandoned cemeteries. [b]They are a frequent place of occurrence of the undead... [/b]Unfortunately, even the mighty forests are not free from their presence. In addition, you will definitely visit mysterious caves, valleys, and groves - be sure to investigate them carefully as they may hide unexpected riches and valuable loot. There are also ancient ruins in the forests - if you manage to find them, you can be sure that an [b]amazing, yet dangerous adventure awaits you[/b] 🏛 Such ruins may be full of traps, hostile creatures, and darkness, but where there is danger, there is reward. Grab your torch and sword, and break into the depths of the forgotten dungeons... if you dare, of course.

Soon we will come back to you with more descriptions of the amazing creatures inhabiting the world of Gimle. You will learn what they are, what they look like and how to fight them! Be sure to follow our Social Media channels and join the Discord server to stay tuned. Until next time!
[hr][/hr]

notes.title: Know your Enemies! Gimle Bestiary #5 - Bandits
notes.content:
[h2]👋 Góðan daginn, warriors!👋 [/h2]

No matter how far back we look into the history of mankind, there has always been a group of people who [b]prioritized their own good[/b] and wealth over the well-being and even lives of their fellow kin. 

They are not used to living off the hard work of their own hands, and it is in vain to look for them in honest workplaces, such as farms, workshops, or stores. 🗡 Oh no, their places of work are mountain trails, forest paths, and hiding places near narrow bridges. [b]The bandits[/b] are the real terror of travelers roaming around the world of Gimle. Remember to always keep your eyes and ears wide open... but make no mistake - one gloomy day you will meet them too.


[url=https://discord.gg/8KnCYpm2xT][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41450177/5bd7570ac75752cdf33a3579a783ea3f93dfdc3a.png[/img][/url]

Today, we will take a closer look at their [b]inglorious profession[/b] and consider the best tactic for interacting with a pack of greedy bandits (though this interaction is usually limited to the simple choice: coin or life). The trick is to make sure this isn't your life that gets taken 💀


[h2]The life of an outlaw[/h2]
[hr][/hr]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41450177/65a3be894f20d9a18351a4582db135374eeded8b.png[/img]

How does one become a bandit? Well, it's quite simple. You leave your homeland and set off into the unknown - from now on, all you need is something to cover your face, sharp steel, and the strength of your arm. [b]There are numerous circumstances[/b] that make the people of Gimle abandon honest jobs and set off on a road to plunder and rob 😈 Poverty, unfair harm, a desire to get rich, or the call of adventure are only to begin with! 

We have to remember, that bandit's life is very [b]unpredictable and risky[/b]. It is not uncommon for some of them to [b]end their careers during the first ambush[/b] - either on the end of a rope or with their backs studded with the arrows of caravan guards. Travelers often know how to defend themselves efficiently and can hurt unfortunate thieves really, really bad.

On the other hand, a successful robbery can mean acquiring wealth for which the common man would have to work for many long years 💰 Experienced bandits who know their trade are known to be very wealthy, well-equipped, and [b]deadly dangerous. [/b]


[h2]Appearance[/h2]
[hr][/hr]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41450177/eb3560a8356d557d9237374da4ce43e5fda8340d.png[/img]

As you surely suspect, the bandits often wear hoods and bandanas over their heads and faces. Maintaining [b]anonymity is extremely important[/b] in this profession. The faces of careless outlaws can get imprinted in travelers' memory or end up in the 'wanted' poster 📜 - and that's what they want to avoid! 

Bandits most often wear armor made of cloth or leather (although sometimes you can meet heavier armored individuals) because they do not make any unwanted sounds and allow for a [b]silent approach to the victim[/b]. Depending on the place of operation, the colors of their clothes are brown, greenish, gray, black, and even white - all this to help them blend in with the background.

The bandit way is attractive mainly to [b]young people from smaller towns and villages[/b], and that's who you can expect when getting attacked. Of course, there are also real veterans among them, but they are a fairly rare sight. 💪


[h2]How to fight them?[/h2]
[hr][/hr]
In this case, much depends on [b]the right assessment of the situation.[/b] Does the gang that attacked you have a significant advantage in numbers? Are they well-equipped? Are you alone? 🤔 A quick analysis of the circumstances will help you decide whether it is better to fight or try to find another solution. Sometimes the best way is to just give them what they want and walk away peacefully. But for many proud Vikings, [b]surrendering is not an option... [/b]

If you are one of them, you'd better get your weapons ready ⚔ Fighting bandits does not differ much from fighting other representatives of the human race. Some of your opponents will be quick and effective, others will not pose much of a challenge. Try to choose your position so as not to get surrounded by your foes. [b]Another piece of advice[/b] is to avoid archers and their deadly arrows 🏹 Make sure that at least one member of the gang is always in the way between the bandit shooters and you! 

Bandits are almost never heavily armored, so don't hesitate to adopt a more aggressive fighting style - sometimes the best defense strategy is a wild, quick attack. If you manage to emerge victorious, don't forget to collect your bounty - outlaws' pockets are often full of looted coins and valuables! 💎

notes.title: Gimle Lore Book #2 - Ragnarok
notes.content:
[h1] Góðan Daginn Vikings! [/h1]
[hr][/hr]
Sit back and prick up your ears, warriors! The tale you are about to hear is so bloody, heroic, and terrifying that some call it unbelievable. [b]Oh... but it happened[/b]. In today's devblog, we will present you the history of the Old World and Ragnarok that led to its end. However, do not be afraid, as every legend, even the darkest one, has a [b]spark of light[/b] in it... and this very spark gave rise to the New World known as Gimle.


[url=https://discord.gg/hBecggyvyb][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41450177/5bd7570ac75752cdf33a3579a783ea3f93dfdc3a.png[/img][/url]
[h3]And share other amazing tales with our team and community...[/h3]


[h2]Ragnarok[/h2]
[hr][/hr]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41450177/692e03fe50801ee25277bd42750fedb3797f9a55.png[/img]

[b]According to the prophecy, Ragnarok had to be preceded by three important events:[/b]

[list]
[*]Death of [b]Baldur [/b]- the god of goodness, beauty and wisdom
[*]The birth of the three children of Loki and Angrboða: dreadful wolf [b]Fenrir[/b], a giant snake entwining Midgard named [b]Jörmungandr[/b], and goddess of the dishonorable dead - [b]Hel[/b]
[*]A three-year winter called [b]Fimbulvinter[/b], which was to be the harshest winters ever seen
[/list]

The character we'll start our story with is Loki, a Jötunn, once counted among the Aesir as the god of deception and mischief. According to ancient legends, it was he who was to take command of the army marching on the divine realm of Asgard and its people. But let us start from the beginning.

Before Loki's heart filled with hate and resentment, he was a frequent and welcome visitor to Asgard... well, at least until he got under someone's skin with his malicious nature. He was invited to Asgard by Odin himself, who - with the use of a special blood pact - made them brothers. Odin promised that his guest's blood would never be shed by the Aesir, even despite the fact that Loki was Jötunn. 

In the past, Loki often played tricks on other gods, sometimes malicious to the point where Thor wanted to take his revenge and simply crush him with his storm-enhanced hammer. The point of no return, however, was the murder of [b]Baldur[/b] - the embodiment of good, beauty, and wisdom. Insidious Loki tricked Baldur's blind brother named Hodur and made him unintentionally shoot an arrow at his otherwise invulnerable brother. That event caused Loki to be banished from Asgard and chained to a rock in a deep, dark cave. The gods of Asgard decided to put a venomous snake just above Loki's head and made it drip its burning poison... forever.

Although his wife [b]Sigyn[/b] tried to mitigate Loki's torment by holding a bowl over his head to collect the snake's venom, the scorching drops sometimes found their way to his body, causing him unimaginable pain. The rage and a lust for revenge grew in imprisoned Jötunn and made him imagine how he would repay Odin and all the Aesir for the wrongs they had done to him.

In a completely different place, just after the great winter of Fimbulvinter ended, [b]Sköll and Hati[/b] - two dire wolves chasing the sun and the moon - finally caught up with their prey. The roosters of Asgard, Jotunheim, and Niflheim did not stay idle and crowed alarmingly, to which [b]Garm[/b], the great hound guarding the gates of Helheim, replied with his terrifying roar.

The next stages of the prophecy unfolded. Loki managed to break free from his shackles and, full of anger and lust for vengeance, assembled an army of his racial kin, Jotnar. His ranks were strengthened by his two sons: the giant wolf [b]Fenrir[/b], who also broke free from his bonds, and the mighty serpent [b]Jörmungandr[/b], who emerged from the depths of the ocean. The undead legions from the underworld of Helheim also heeded the Loki's call and joined him under the command of his daughter Hel. The last force in Jötunn's revenge-hungry army were the fiery Giants called Muspells, commanded by their fiery lord Surtr.

And so, the Loki's forces were ready to attack. Soon the army found itself on the enormous ship Naglfar and set off to its destination. As soon as the divine guardian [b]Heimdall [/b]saw the impending threat, he immediately blew the horn of [b]Gjallarhorn [/b]to inform all the gods of Asgard and the warriors of Valhalla of the oncoming battle. The great war deciding the fate of reality itself was about to begin.


[h2]The course of the battle[/h2]
[hr][/hr]
Short after landing, both armies rushed towards each other. Asgard was filled with the clash of weapons, battle cries, and the screams of the dying. The day of the sword and axe finally came. In the midst of the tumult, thousands of fighting warriors, and pure chaos, there were a few remarkably significant clashes.

The first to die was [b]Freyr[/b], the son of the mighty Vanr [b]Njord[/b], who was unable to defend himself as he lacked the weapon he once gave up in order to find his beloved Gerdr. The god of war [b]Tyr [/b]fought his duel with Garm, but died in his devouring maw, killing the beast with a powerful blow just before he fell. [b]Thor [/b]finally stood up against his ancient enemy, [b]Jörmungandr[/b]. The god of thunders struck Jörmungandr with enormous force, dealing him a killing blow. Thor could not enjoy the victory for too long, however, because Jörmungandr poisoned him with his last breath.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41450177/ef4ddd4fbabe7dd39981e957d869449bfc759726.png[/img]

[b]Loki [/b]died fighting [b]Heimdallr[/b]. They both fought bravely and, till the very last breath, neither of them could emerge victorious. They both died from the dozens of wound they received during the fierce combat. This bloody day, however, was to consume even more notable, glorious figures...

No one, not even the father of Asgard, great Odin, can escape their destiny. The commander of the army of the gods and warriors of Valhalla was crushed in the powerful jaws of the wolf Fenrir, just as prophesied. [b]Fenrir [/b]was the Allfather's nightmare until the very end, heralding his death. When Odin's death was noticed by Vidar, the silent god, he immediately moved towards Fenrir, and having the wolf's mouth opened, he stabbed him in the heart with a spear.

At the very end, when almost all the gods had fallen and only the warriors of Valhalla remained on the battlefield, the ruler of Muspells [b]Surtr [/b]drew his sword and swung it so hard he set fire to Asgard and the whole Yggdrasil tree, including all its worlds. The flame consumed everything in its path, not sparing both the Asgard and Loki's armies. Even Surtr himself and his Muspell warriors could not escape this destructive force. There was only fire... everywhere...


[h2]The end and the beginning[/h2]
[hr][/hr]
Finally, the burning Yggdrasil tree began to sink in the waters of the [b]Endless Ocean[/b]. The hiss of extinguished flames filled the reality, and when the very last of burning leafs on the Yggdrasil crown plunged into the water... there was nothing. Impenetrable darkness and deaf silence, just as in the Ginnungagap emptiness, began their reign.

This way the prophecy about Ragnarok came true, exactly as the [b]Norn [/b]sisters, who weaved the fate of the whole world, had predicted. And although Odin and the gods of Asgard tried to change the course of the prophecy, neither of them succeeded. But the fate of the reality was not to end like this...

notes.title: Lands of Gimle - Cartographer's Notes #4 - Caves and Ruins
notes.content:
[h2]👋 Góðan daginn, Travelers!👋 [/h2]

Brace yourselves! Today we are going on a journey to a very dark, dangerous place... right in the [b]depths of the underworld[/b]. What awaits us there? A fight? A mystery? Or maybe valuable loot? We know one thing for sure - you will need a torch 🔥 and lots and lots of courage. In a moment, we will discover the secrets of the Caves and Ruins, which you will surely come across in the [b]post-Ragnarok world[/b] of Gimle. Pack your things and here we go!


[url=https://discord.gg/8KnCYpm2xT][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41450177/5bd7570ac75752cdf33a3579a783ea3f93dfdc3a.png[/img][/url]
[h3]and talk to the community and developers about the game![/h3]


Caves and Ruins are fairly common, although they are not always easy to spot. Thanks to the Cartographer's Notes, however, we know how to find and explore them. Ancient scrolls mention that such places are adored by certain [b]mythical creatures and beasts[/b]. It is time to disturb their peace and free the local people from their murderous habits... or to get our hands on amazing treasures 😀


[h2]You NEVER know what awaits you in the cave[/h2]
[hr][/hr]
Imagine you are wandering on a mountain trail. You look around, but all you see are rocky slopes and hills... hey, what's that? It's a Cave! And this is where [b]the adventure begins![/b] You must know that each single trip deep into the cave is quite a risk. It's not just about slippery floors, darkness, chasms, and pits. If you browse our Bestiary regularly, you surely know who the frequent inhabitant of the Caves is... that's right! The terrifying and deadly dangerous Troll 💀 A careless wanderer can be swept away by one blow of this enormous beast, so [b]keep your eyes and ears open[/b] no matter what! The Troll, of course, is only one of many creatures on a long list of Cave dwellers. And the grim truth is that there are many more of them.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41450177/8cfdc6e6539ff36680727d3f54cf8de320982a55.png[/img]


The Cave is a natural shelter which protects its inhabitants against burning heat, biting cold, rain, or gusts of wind. It is also a great hideout for those who wish to [b]avoid the excessive attention[/b] of others... such as law enforcers. Inhabitants of mountain villages report, for example, that they are constantly raided by bandits living in the nearby Caves. Some of them even say that these outlaws are not humans 🗡️ Whatever the truth is, they are very difficult to find and exterminate.

Inaccessible, dark, and dangerous [b]Caves often hide amazing secrets[/b]. When you wander their corridors, pay attention to details and unusual elements - sometimes they are the key to solving the tricky puzzle. Mysterious passages, hidden rooms, and new areas are waiting to be explored! With a little luck, you will manage to avoid numerous traps, ambushes, and threats that can end your life in the blink of an eye. Regardless of whether it is by a fight or by a discovery, at the end of your Cave adventure you will often be rewarded with amazing loot. Before taking on the challenge, however, consider whether such a deadly threat is indeed worth it.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41450177/f67d7b5512d8ee14ff16688eb5d815c4ef882fe1.png[/img]


[h2]Abandoned ruins are waiting to be explored[/h2]
[hr][/hr]
While the Caves are natural creations, the Ruins are made by man. Of course, they were not always in such bad, saddening condition and previously served as [b]temples, tombs, or treasuries[/b]. Due to wars, extinction of local people, diseases, or migrations, they were finally forgotten and abandoned. Ruins can be found wherever people used to be - regardless of whether we are talking about small forest chapels or huge mountain strongholds. And where there were once humans, there are also [b]undead[/b] 😨


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41450177/9ae428efba9cb853822c67ab9ddd1996c1bcb756.png[/img]


As you surely suspect, it is the undead that most often inhabit the Ruins. Some of them wandered into their dark corridors from nearby barrows and cemeteries, but the most common sight are dead who were one day buried there. In larger, deeper, and more complex tombs lie significant personalities and adventurers, for even the greatest of this world must someday bow down to death. If you decided to wander to such a place, be ready for some trouble... but also for a [b]great reward[/b]. Just imagine... ⚔️ An adventurer who gathered numerous artifacts and piles of gold during his lifetime, now risen to "life" by dark magic, eternally guarding his treasure with the mindless anger typical to undead creatures. Only[b] the greatest heroes[/b] can come out of such a meeting unscathed. Stories of brave warriors who, tempted by the vision of wealth or glory, have ventured into ancient tombs have been told among the people of Gimle for centuries... most often their ending is rather bitter and gloomy.

However, the Ruins are not only tombs, for many of them are much larger and much more mysterious places. Abandoned mountain fortresses, buildings raised by mythical creatures, magnificent temples, skewed towers... all of them full of puzzles, interesting stories from the past, and intriguing beauty. When you travel through such hostile places, you will quickly discover, that your best friends are [b]a flaming torch and a sharp blade[/b] - and hey! Don't be fooled by the impression that Ruins are empty and abandoned... many of the bones you will pass along your way once belonged to the travelers who assumed so ☠️


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41450177/8bc2c4d588c570f7af8745d41e06d2ab7c00eca0.png[/img]

notes.title: Know Your Enemies! Gimle Bestiary #4 - Trolls
notes.content:
[h2]👋 Góðan daginn, warriors!👋 [/h2]

There are plenty of creatures we know from the Nordic myths that have become a permanent feature of pop culture, games, movies, and comics. And it should come as no surprise - we all know how awesome, complex, and deep they are! However, if we want to talk about a true symbol, the most famous Nordic creature that has made a lasting mark on the culture and tales of the whole North, we all should turn our eyes to... [b]the mighty Troll![/b]


[url=https://discord.gg/8KnCYpm2xT][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41450177/5bd7570ac75752cdf33a3579a783ea3f93dfdc3a.png[/img][/url]


Naturally, such a symbol could not be missing from Gimle, which is full of elements and details straight from the Viking mythology ⚔️ During your adventures, [b]you will surely encounter a Troll[/b] once or twice. And then what...? 🤔 Will you know how to act? Will you take the best tactic? And finally, will you know how to beat this enormous, dreadful beast? Well... all the answers you might need are waiting for you in the bestiary below! Take a moment to learn about the history, appearance, and habits of Trolls - [b]this knowledge can one day save your life![/b]


[h2]The truth about Trolls...[/h2]
[hr][/hr]
All the inhabitants of Gimle who have had the dubious pleasure of meeting the Troll agree, that they are not the smartest and brightest creatures they have seen. That's true, they may be dull, which can be used right against them, but despite that you should never underestimate them! Suffice it to say that getting hit by their clawed hand can simply tear you apart and put your glorious adventurer career to an end. To make things worse, Trolls can throw boulders and use makeshift weapons, such as tree limbs. Its sweeping blows can literally throw an opponent into the air and shatter his bones.

Trolls are[b] predatory, omnivorous giants[/b] that inhabit almost every possible environment - frosty peaks, dense forests, misty swamps, or even windy plains. Depending on their place of existence, they may differ in the skin tones, the thickness of their coat, and the size of their tusks. Their diet is mainly a combination of meat (watch out, they will not despise human flesh! 😱) and mushrooms. 

Trolls are forced to lead a nocturnal lifestyle because sunlight turns them to stone. Therefore, their eyes adapted to see in the dark. They sleep from morning to dusk in their caves or abandoned huts, safe from blinding rays of the sun. Trolls are usually [b]wild and almost mindless[/b], but surprisingly enough, there are individuals who can... talk! Most of the time, however, their level of eloquence reaches the illiterate and simply stupid peasant. Their style of speaking is based on repeating a few words over and over again. Such individuals are usually very, very old and had met people on several occasions.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41450177/706098b1dbc64197cd41fe9c6448eede6ee17368.png[/img]


[h2]Appearance[/h2]
[hr][/hr]
Trolls weigh from six hundred to twelve hundred kilograms and are [b]over three meters tall[/b], despite that they always walk hunched over. If that's not enough, you can recognize them by their large noses, as well as characteristic moss and fur covering their bodies. They have relatively short legs and strong, long arms. Most often they are quite dense, stout, and greasy, some rare individuals have horns.

Trolls are famous for their very hard and thick skin. Their color most often combines various shades of green and brown, but as mentioned above, depending on where they occur, Trolls may significantly differ in their appearance. An example is the Ice Troll (called Timir), which is almost completely white. Trolls are skilled at using their [b]huge, sharp claws[/b] - their hands are disproportionately large, which makes them an excellent survival tool and a deadly weapon ☠️ Witnesses say that Trolls can crush a human warrior with a single, powerful blow as easy as one draws a breath.


[h2]How to fight them?[/h2]
[hr][/hr]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41450177/353826d17252d7056906688eaa6b000af32238e2.png[/img]

When your path leads you to the Troll's cave, consider taking a different way. Trolls, being much larger and stronger than humans, pose a [b]deadly danger.[/b] In addition, it is crucial to remember about their amazing regenerative abilities - legend says that these resilient beasts can even regrow severed limbs! This means that only powerful, deep wounds will be able to hold them back. 

Be sure to take advantage of the fact that Trolls are rather slow. Before you rush into close combat, weaken the enemy by using a few spells or a ranged weapon. At the same time, bear in mind that some types of [b]Trolls may be immune[/b] to certain elements, such as ice and fire! 🔥❄️ 

The intellectual advantage is definitely on your side, so scan your surroundings and choose the best position that will slow the Troll down and give you some time to fire at it or think what to do next. The truth is that only the greatest warriors can defeat them in single combat, so make sure you are properly equipped and ready to fight these murderous giants. Most likely, heavy weapons that can deal high damage will work best here, although this is not a universal rule. [b]Fame and glory await...[/b] at least for those who don't end up as a bloody scrap just outside the Troll's cave entrance ✊

notes.title: Lands of Gimle - Cartographer's Notes #3 - Graveyards
notes.content:
[h2]👋 Góðan daginn, Travelers!👋 [/h2]

Put on your shoes and throw the backpack over your shoulder! Today, once again, we are going on a long journey to visit the most [b]amazing and breathtaking places[/b] in the gloomy world of Gimle. Fortunately, we have our cartographer's notes with us, so this task should be a bit easier. Okay, are you ready? Good! Let's set off on [b]an expedition to visit...[/b]


[url=https://discord.gg/8KnCYpm2xT][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41450177/5bd7570ac75752cdf33a3579a783ea3f93dfdc3a.png[/img][/url]
[h3]and talk to the community and developers about the game![/h3]


[b]...the Graveyards! [/b]💀 👻 That's right - graveyards are an integral part of the Gimle landscape and a very important element of the culture of the local population. Let us honor their customs and get to know them better... but before we go, we have to warn you - the truth about misty cemeteries we will soon visit may turn out to be much deeper than it seems at first.


[h2]Cemeteries as an indispensable element of culture[/h2]
[hr][/hr]
As mentioned above, people of Gimle attach great importance to the afterlife and the burial of their dead. Perhaps it is due to their[b] deep respect for tradition[/b], or perhaps they are aware of the fact, that life in this dangerous realm is fragile and fleeting. 

Anyway, you can be sure that Vikings never give up on the burial of their loved ones, even if it is associated with high risk and danger. They always respect the bodies, do their best to bury them with honor, and guarantee them a peaceful rest... which, unfortunately, does not always happen. In a Viking grave, you can find many interesting items that the deceased [b]used during their lifetime[/b]. These can be - weapons, ⚔️  jewelry, trinkets, favorite items of everyday life, and even the remains of their animal companions - anything that can come in handy in the afterlife. When the time of the burial finally comes, family members and friends of the deceased gather around to mourn and pay their respect for the very last time. The final stage of the ceremony is laying the body in the grave.

The greatest of this world - Jarls, wise elders, or heroes - are sent to the other side in a very demonstrative and respectful way 👑 Their bodies are placed in a decorated boat filled with all kinds of valuables and artifacts, and then are pushed out into the water and set on fire. Such burials are rare and always arouse the great interest of the local population - [b]what a way to go![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41450177/649aacfe262720adf0b89ed28dafda39882e295f.jpg[/img]

[h2]What awaits you after entering the graveyard?[/h2]
[hr][/hr]
In this case, it depends on the [b]location and purpose[/b] of the graveyard. Those near the city or other large settlement will be rather bigger and better kept than a tiny (and often forgotten) cemeteries near the small villages. 

One way or another, they are most often surrounded by a stone wall that defines their boundaries. Families of the rich and important citizens can afford to build a deep, magnificent tomb, while the poorer have to be content only with [b]a tombstone or even a wooden slab[/b]. Thanks to special boards, you can find out who is buried in a given grave - unfortunately, some of the inscriptions have already been obliterated by time and weather ⌛️ 

Often, in honor of the dead, people place candles on the graves of their loved ones. You will spot them easily among the fog and humidity that often prevails here. Remember, that whatever your motives are, graveyards are not good places to visit alone... when you walk on soft soil around the tombstones, always keep your eyes and ears wide open. If you're lucky, you will never hear the tormented grunts and the sound of the rattling bones 💀 But if you do...

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41450177/ac1bdf2d2b1d2df1ff69c6c8e17e9aa17bb91567.jpg[/img]

[h2]The Undead[/h2]
[hr][/hr]
As you probably already know, the inhabitants of Gimle are not easy to scare, but even the bravest warrior can feel a chill in his bones at the sight of a living dead - [b]a real plague[/b] that disturbs the peace and natural order of life and death ☠️ Risen from their graves, the undead seem to have only one purpose - to erase all living things. Why is this happening? What causes such hatred and a mindless desire to destroy? Well... all we know is that the Undead are somehow related to the [b]ancient magic of the old, pre-Ragnarok world.[/b] Who knows, maybe some great adventurer will someday explore this mystery and shed light on this strange, terrifying situation...



[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41450177/afe73aad0f8c8cb14b2f5edf1a14a0983b4f0e8b.jpg[/img]


It's easy to conclude that the [b]awakening of the dead makes it difficult [/b]for the people of Gimle to carry out their funeral traditions, visit graves, or even approach cemeteries. Each such attempt is risky and may eventually end up with making the army of the undead even larger... Fortunately, there are still a few brave heroes fighting on the living side 👊 thanks to them, the dead that rose to life can finally experience eternal peace. In some tombs, they may find a great reward for their struggles and hardships - it is said, that ancient, [b]powerful items and astonishing treasures[/b] can be found there.

notes.title: Know Your Enemies! Gimle Bestiary #3 - Vargrs
notes.content:
[h2]👋 Góðan daginn, warriors!👋 [/h2]

The world of Gimle was originally intended to be a wonderful place, free from problems and dangers... well, unfortunately this vision has been distorted, as the lands of Gimle are filled with all kinds of hostile creatures and perils. Consequently, [b]mankind had two options: to adapt or to die[/b] 💀 Fortunately, the brave survivors of the dreadful Ragnarök chose the first. 


[url=https://discord.gg/8KnCYpm2xT][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41450177/5bd7570ac75752cdf33a3579a783ea3f93dfdc3a.png[/img][/url]


If you want to face the dangers, you better get to know them well - so says the old saying. So today we are going to tell you a tale about an incredibly [b]dangerous and sinister creature.[/b] When you are within range of its sharp fangs or claws, know that you are in serious trouble. To prevent this from happening, be sure to learn more about the habits, appearance, and history of Vargrs from the bestiary below! 📚


[h2]When the Vargr gets in your way...[/h2]
[hr][/hr]
You will easily distinguish Vargr from an ordinary wolf. It's not just its enormous size and much more massive body. When you look into its eyes - the eyes of a [b]descendant of the giant wolf Fenrir[/b], as some say - you will quickly find out that you are in for a really tough fight. There is a frightening lust for blood in Vargr's focused, cunning gaze. Its bristled fur and bared fangs could scare even the greatest warrior... which would be a huge mistake, as the beast can easily [b]sense the fear of its victims.[/b]


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41450177/389a62b13b889f6faef74a2b5c8b7c0046dceb9d.png[/img]


[h2]Appearance[/h2]
[hr][/hr]
Vargrs in their appearance resemble wolves, but they are much [b]larger, stronger, and more intelligent.[/b] One of their hallmarks is the thick fur around the nape, chest, and neck. Their eyes are yellow and shiny. Vargr most often has a black, dark brown, or white coat, depending on the subspecies and place of birth and residence.

Its length (without the tail) can reach up to 2.5 meters and the height up to 1.3 meters. The weight of this beast can reach up to 230 kilograms. It would therefore seem that Vargr is slow and sluggish... the truth however is quite different 🐺 Running away from Vargr is a very difficult task. Both during the run and fight, it is a very fast opponent - many great warriors did not even notice when[b] its great fangs[/b] sank into their necks.


[h2]How to fight them?[/h2]
[hr][/hr]
Let's start with the fact, that Vargrs are known to live in wolf packs, often in the role of the pack leaders. Packs consisting entirely or mostly of Vargrs are very rare due to their[b] dominant nature.[/b] A single Vargr is able to defeat much larger and stronger creatures, however, their most deadly weapon is their ability to command other members of the pack. A bloodthirsty group following its leader can easily overwhelm any foe 😱

When the circumstances force you to fight Vargr, it is best to wear any type of armor available. The beast's powerful jaws can simply tear an unprotected body apart. If you have the opportunity, take a few shots at the pack before it approaches you. Remember that [b]Vargr is the most dangerous creature[/b] in the whole group - make sure to take care of it first!

notes.title: Lands of Gimle - Cartographer's Notes #2 - Krinbridge
notes.content:
[h2]👋 Góðan daginn, travelers!👋 [/h2]

We are [b]very excited[/b] about the second part of the Land of Gimle - Cartographer's Notes series! The world of Gimle is filled with all kinds of varied and very succulent zones that we wanted to tell you about from the very beginning of our work on this project... [b]and so our journey begins![/b]

The following entry describing the town of Krinbridge is just the beginning of an extensive series thanks to which you will get to know the [b]most important places you will visit[/b] while traveling the in-game world. Together we will visit snow-capped mountain peaks, forgotten dungeons, crowded villages, foggy swamps, dense forests, and much, much more! Are you ready for the foretaste? 😀 Sure you are! Let's take a look at the city of [b]Krinbridge[/b]...



[url=https://discord.gg/8KnCYpm2xT][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41450177/5bd7570ac75752cdf33a3579a783ea3f93dfdc3a.png[/img][/url]
[h3]...and talk to the community and developers about the game![/h3]



[h2]Welcome to Krinbridge[/h2]
[hr][/hr]
Krinbridge is a settlement of the [b]nation known as Lifmen[/b]. A distinctive feature of the city is that it is crossed by the river Dreyria. The settlement is thus divided into two districts - southern and northern - which are connected by a large, solid bridge made of wood and stone. The bridge was built over the years at the river's narrowest point and is a true icon of the city.

Speaking of the river, Krinbridge is the first outpost to be established partly on the other side of Dreyria and the idea behind choosing this place was to carry out a reconnaissance of new lands beyond its other shore. 💦 The settlement is therefore an excellent source of valuable materials and endless possibilities.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41450177/7690e0d6077030304834c41b6f31840c3826e16c.png[/img]


Krinbridge is inhabited by just [b]over a hundred people[/b], which makes it one of the smaller cities in the world of Gimle, however its dynamic development means that new residents are flowing in very quickly. It was created in times of the great famine, when people migrated south in search of Yggdrasil's pieces, food, and new terrains to settle.

The city's rapid development is evidenced by the presence of many important [b]workshops and institutions[/b] such as the market square, river port, warehouse, lumber mill, armorer, blacksmith, and even an inn. Any adventurer can easily replenish their supplies here, repair their equipment, or simply rest before taking up the next quest. 🛏️ It is worth noting that the settlement is located in the same province as Lifborg, the capital of the Lifmen nation. 


[h2]The people[/h2]
[hr][/hr]
Lifmen are proud and careful people, but anyone who gains their trust can count on their kindness and support. The residents of Krinbridge may prove to be a [b]valuable source of information[/b] - remember to take a moment to talk to them while visiting the city. The population is quite diverse and craves all kinds of workers and craftsmen. It is said that any honest, hardworking person can live a happy life here... but woe to you if you are a fraud or a thief! The people of Krinbridge will soon see right through you.

Currently, the village is mainly inhabited by scouts, hunters, and fishermen, however, with the influx of new residents, this situation is changing. Kilnbridge is the [b]most dynamically developing settlement of Lifmen.[/b] Interestingly, it mainly attracts young people who are looking for their chance to gain fortune, wealth, or want to experience the thrill of adventure.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41450177/37aee094bf3da47d0cd5b09bdb8561922e5518cf.png[/img]


In the very center of the city, just next to the bridge, you will find the [b]Headman's house[/b]. It is he who makes the most important decisions regarding the further fate of the settlement. His estate is the largest building in the area and stands out from the rest of the houses, which are rather modest and mainly made of wood. To ensure the safety of its inhabitants, Kilnbridge is surrounded by a palisade topped with two gates - the northern and the southern one. 

When you approach them, you can expect a few questions from the cautious guards. If you earn their trust, the whole Krinbridge will be open for you to explore. 🗺️

notes.title: Know Your Enemies! Gimle Bestiary #2 - Aptrgangr
notes.content:
[h2]👋 Góðan daginn, warriors!👋 [/h2]


Today, we will blow the dust off the ancient bestiary of the world of Gimle once again and take a closer look at the enemies that sow fear and uncertainty in the hearts of even the bravest adventurers. Their massive silhouettes and contorted faces are a truly terrifying sight, heralding an imminent battle.

In order to defeat such a powerful enemy, you must first get to know him! That is why our scribes wrote down all their knowledge about Aptrgangras, who are sure to stand in your way as you travel through the world of Gimle. Let's see what they have prepared for us!



[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41450177/0bbaa45fb42bcbfc5ddcd32b86b509e309737d2a.png[/img]


[h2]Who are the Aptrgangras[/h2]
[hr][/hr]
The good place to start will be letting you know, that the Aptrgangras are part of a larger group of undead known as the Draugrs. However, mentioned Draugrs are much smaller and simply weaker than Aptrgangras. Each Aptrgangr was in life an exceptionally large man or had some other unique powers. In addition, Aptrgangras are known from their great aggression and [b]impressive combat skills[/b], the neglect of which may turn out to be a critical mistake.

They are driven by the insatiable desire to inflict pain, suffering and need to kill all living beings. The more victims they kill, the stronger they become, [b]consuming their life energy.[/b] Aptrgangr can often be seen in the company of the more numerous and weaker undead he leads.

[h2]Appearance[/h2]
[hr][/hr]
At first glance, Aptrgangr looks like a very muscular, tall man. As a result of the dark magic, the bodies of these creatures [b]grow to unnatural sizes[/b], making them larger and more massive than almost all mortals. Their skin is bluish - sometimes bones or torn tendons and flesh disgustingly stick out of their bodies. Aptrgangras are often adorned with faded tattoos and scars from wounds sustained during their lifetime.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41450177/669b7b2fa0a56fc7978272aafe2d4ed49dd6a705.png[/img]


It is the mighty warriors who most often turn into Aptrgangres, so it happens that they [b]are armed with powerful, but rusty and cracked armor[/b]. They love brutal hand-to-hand combat with huge two-handed axes or deadly hammers.

[h2]Combat[/h2]
[hr][/hr]
Unfortunately for adventurers, the Aptrgangras are not without a tactical sense and a twisted intelligence. During the battle, you should watch out for their [b]audacious charges[/b], murderous melee attacks and powerful ground-shaking hits. They are quite tough and resilient opponents who are [b]not in the habit of fleeing or surrendering[/b]. On the contrary - legends passed down by warriors say that wounded and enraged Aptrgangr becomes even more dangerous and blood thirsty with each hit taken!

notes.title: Gimle Lore Book #1 - The Old World
notes.content:
[hr][/hr]
[url=https://discord.gg/hBecggyvyb][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41450177/5bd7570ac75752cdf33a3579a783ea3f93dfdc3a.png[/img][/url]
[hr][/hr]

[h1] Góðan Daginn Vikings! [/h1]
[hr][/hr]
[b]Today's episode of Gimle Lore Book will be the first part of three in which we will discuss the history of the in-game world. In the beginning, we will go back in time to the era of the Old World, which existed before Gimle was created.[/b]

The game world consists of many varied elements and mixed together they make it absolutely unique. Before we talk about them, however, we want to outline how it all began, so the best place to start will be the very beginning...

[h2]Birth of the Old World[/h2]
[hr][/hr]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41450177/8ffc149da06ce2773f19a30a7a4e00c027f885e4.png[/img]

Before the creation of the world and the emergence of life, there was an enormous dark void called [b]Ginnungagap[/b]. Two worlds emerged from within the void: Niflheim, ice-bound and dark, and [b]Muspeheim[/b], blazing with eternal fire.

The lands that were initially distant from each other began to come closer. When they finally met near the center of the Ginnungagp, the Muspelheim fire began to melt the thick ice of Niflheim, forming droplets that breathed life into the first Jötunn called [b]Ymir[/b]. It was this first giant that gave rise to his entire race, the representatives of which left his body while he slept. Another creature that arose from the melting ice of Nifelheim was [b]Audhumla[/b], a gigantic cow. By licking salty blocks of ice, Audhumla gave Ymir milk to grow in strength and size. However licking the blocks resulted in another strange occurrence. As time passed, hair emerged from within the ice...  the next was whole head and finnaly, on the third day, a man called [b]Buri[/b] was free from the shackles of ice.

Buri was the first of Aesir to appear, along with his son [b]Borre[/b]. At first, both men lived on Audhumla's milk. Borr married the giant Bestla, daughter of the giant Bolthorn. They named their half-god - half-giant child Odin. In addition to [b]Odin[/b], his brothers Vili and Ve were also born, but it was Odin who became the ruler of all As.

Odin and his brothers killed the gigantic Ymir and created the world from his body. They used his blood to create oceans, muscles and skin to form soil, hair made vegetation, brain clouds, and sky was made of Ymir's skull. The As then made the first female, [b]Embla[/b], and the first male, Aska, from two tree trunks. Fearing Jotnar, the As provided the people their own world - Mitgard, and the giants left for themselves created their own world - [b]Jotunheim[/b].

[h2]Yggdrasil and the Nine Worlds[/h2]
[hr][/hr]
Over time, many new races and worlds have been born into existence. The As settled in their own realm, which was called [b]Asgard[/b], leaving humans in Mirgard. There was also a new race of gods called Wanami that took up residence in [b]Vanaheim[/b]. The worlds of Muspelheim and [b]Nifelheim [/b]still existed as two primordial worlds on opposite sides of reality. The realm of fire was inhabited by fiery giants called [b]Muspells[/b]. The Elves of Light found their home in [b]Alfheim[/b], and the Elves of Darkness settled in [b]Svartalfheim[/b]. After a long time, arose the world of the dead - a gloomy place for people who have suffered an unworthy death. This world is named [b]Helheim [/b]after its ruler [b]Hel[/b].

All Nine Worlds were situated on the great tree of life called [b]Yggdrasil[/b].

[h3][b]The Nine Worlds:[/b][/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41450177/6d5adfae02eeb1447498db0324e1958309a7393f.png[/img]
[b]• Asgard[/b] - Home of the main dynasty of gods - the Aesir
[b]• Vanaheim [/b]- Home of the older race of gods - Vanir
[b]• Niflheim [/b]- The land of fog, ice and cold
[b]• Svartalfheim[/b] - A world inhabited by the Dark Elves
[b]• Midgard [/b]- A world inhabited by humans at the center of the Yggdrasil tree
[b]• Helheim [/b]- The icy land of the dead located at the bottom of the tree
[b]• Jotunheim[/b] - A world inhabited by Jötnar, a race of giants that will attack the Aesir
[b]• Muspelheim[/b] - The land of eternal fire, inhabited by fiery giants called Muspells
[b]• Alfheim [/b]- A world inhabited by Elves of Light

Unfortunately, according to the prophecy, Nine Worlds, including Ygddrasil, had to meet their end in the face of an inevitable war between Ass and [b]Loki [/b]allied with the army of Jotnar, the undead of Helheim and Muspells. Although the prophecy was known to everyone for a long time, no one wanted to believe that it could not be changed... Especially Odin, also known as the Allfather, who, being the most powerful of the gods and having almost everything in his possession, was to die in the jaw of the great wolf [b]Fenrir[/b].

For hundreds, if not thousands of years, Odin tried to acquire the necessary knowledge to change the fate of the world. He sacrificed his eye to [b]the Well of Mimir[/b] to gain access to its knowledge, he hanged himself on the Yggdrasil tree to understand[b] the runic magic[/b], and traveled all over the worlds to get as much information as possible... Unfortunately, all his actions were in vain, because [b]Ragnarok[/b](that was the name of the coming war) finally became a fact...

notes.title: Lands of Gimle - Cartographer's Notes #1 - Lifborg
notes.content:
[h1] Góðan Daginn Vikings! [/h1]
[hr][/hr]
In today's Devlog, we will tell you about the locations in the game for the first time. The first location will be the capital of all Lifians, which is Lifborg. In addition, we are announcing the upcoming big changes to the game, which we will soon be able to reveal straight from the game engine!

Ragnarok, the great war between the gods and the giants is over. The Old World was burned by the fire of Surtr, and the New World emerged from the depths of the Endless Ocean - Gimle. New people also came to the New World - Lif and Lifthrasir, who, according to the prophecy, gave rise to a new human race - Lifians. Their first building ever created gave rise to Lifborg.

[h2]Overview[/h2]
[hr][/hr]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41450177/f1b1e40a6e45b5895a98bbd3b396457e6f7d4b94.png[/img]

Lifborg is the oldest city and the present capital of Lifians, situated in the center of Lifian Kingdom founded by the first people of Gimle. The River Lifgefandiá flows through the city, also known as the Life-Giving River, which is one of the most important symbols of the city. Lifborg is the most spacious city with the most inhabitants. The city is divided into several districts. Each of them has its own unique meaning for the city and its inhabitants, fulfills the functions assigned to it and has its own unique atmosphere.

The city is ruled by Harald - Konungr of Lifians, who was elected by the congregation of Jarl and the Sage as heir to the throne after his father, who also reigned as Konungr. Although Konungr is elected under Lifian law, and the capital of the kingdom varies according to the clan of the person who is currently elected Harald, as a descendant of the previous Konungr he was chosen by the Jarls for his courage, wisdom and courage, which he displayed himself, not because of its title. blood ties.

[h2]History[/h2]
[hr][/hr]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41450177/069aaa5cbd9d08c0fb613541282481913c9e99c9.png[/img]

Lifborg is the oldest city ever built. Its founders are the first people on Gimle, after whom Lifborg was named after them At first, the tiny house that Lifthrasir lived with his wife Lif and his children over the course of hundreds of years developed into the status of a giant city with thousands of inhabitants.

Lifborg has grown and changed significantly over the course of hundreds of years. While the city has not always been formally recognized as the capital city, it has been so in the hearts of many Lifians, especially its inhabitants. The city has gone through numerous ups and downs, wars, and treaties. It witnessed both the fall of rulers, rebellions, and betrayals, and also the birth of hope, the beginnings of new ideas, and the formation of new alliances. The history and importance of Lifborg significantly distinguish the city from others and makes it a real cradle of Lifians culture.

Lifborg was the first, historic capital of a kingdom whose first king was Atli, elected hundreds of years ago. Thanks to this, Lifborg gained a special meaning and it is here that the Sage has his seat, who, as the only person who has the possibility of contact with Odin, watches over the faith and unity of Lifians and over the fulfillment of God's will. The sage has three powerful organizations called Circles to help. Melkolf currently holds this honorable function.

The capital, like every city, also has the seats of the Circles - Hlif, Visindi, and Kanna. The circles play an enormous role in the life of Lifians. Each of the Circles, from the time of their appointment by one of the Sages, plays a key role in the Lifian society. The essence of the Circle is to fulfill the role it has been given, to cooperate with other Circles, and to fulfill the will of the Sage. The circles also help Jarl and Konugr, but most of all they try to achieve the goal for which they were established beyond divisions in the hierarchy of society.

[h2]Architecture[/h2]
[hr][/hr]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41450177/9c6735bcf22393229006ce10e66a9cf33aca636a.png[/img]

Each city in the kingdom has its own architectural style. The architecture of Lifborg is characterized by quality, elegance, exceptional workmanship, and monumentality of buildings located in the city center, connected with wooden, often poorly made buildings located on the outskirts, which significantly emphasizes the problem of social differences in the city.

There are many multi-story buildings in the city center. There is a crush here and a fast pace of life. Although wood is the predominant building material, in the center of Lifborg you can often find buildings whose main material is processed stone. Thanks to this, the most important buildings of LIfborg are extremely durable and strong, but it is much harder to provide them with adequate heat and the construction process takes longer. On the other hand, low-quality buildings made of wood prevail at the city walls and gates, and beyond that in front of the walls, you can often find even makeshift tents and shelters for people who cannot find a place in Lifborg, due to the difficulties in getting a home in the city. The outskirts of the city are also characterized by a much greater thinning and calm, but also poverty and dirt

[h3]The most important places in Lifborg are:[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]Long House of Konungr[/b] - Place of residence of the currently reigning Konungra or Jarl.
[*] [b]Sage's Seat[/b] - The place where the Sage lives with his successor and the Sage's Adepts
[*] [b]Circles' Camps [/b]- Inhabited by members of a particular Circle, they allow for the coordination and organization of Circle activities in the province.
[*] [b]Clan Houses[/b] - Inhabited by clan heads and the most important clan members
[*] [b]Sewers[/b] - Due to their size and span, they allow you to travel almost everywhere in the city.
[*] [b]Main Market[/b] - The most lively place in the whole of Lifborg, which attracts traders from all over Gimle with a chance to earn money.
[*] [b]Vingrad Merchants' Guild House[/b] - House belonging to influential members of Vingrad Merchants' Guild
[*] [b]Gothis' Ritual Circle [/b]- A place where various rituals are performed, especially the one that blesses the Althing.
[/list]

Although the prevailing hustle and bustle, dirt and the visible social gap among residents may discourage newcomers to Lifborg at first glance, the city still has beautiful places, unique personalities, unprecedented holidays and majestic buildings that can impress most visitors over time.


[h2]Citizens[/h2]
[hr][/hr]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41450177/cd5afd08c38779258a2d28237473f53b784e0933.png[/img]

The people of Lifborg are Lifestans who are very proud of their origin, united with their city and Konungr Harald. The society of Lifborg is characterized by exceptional loyalty, courage, obedience, and faith. Unfortunately, the people of Lifborg have long struggled with social inequalities and poverty. While the current Konungr Harald is trying to solve the scarcity problem in Lifborg, which is appreciated by the people, unfortunately, it is too complex a problem to be easily dealt with.

Due to its central location in the kingdom, Lifborg is at the heart of inter-city commerce. Many merchants and goods pass through the city every day, thanks to which the inhabitants of Lifborg have a very wide range full of exotic goods, and thousands of commercial transactions take place in the city every day. In addition to the highly developed trade, the inhabitants of Lifborg often witness many festivals, holidays, and rituals, in which they often participate. Due to the very strong faith of the inhabitants of Lifborg in Odin and the presence of the Sage and priests in the city, cyclical rituals of worshiping the All-Father have become an integral part of their lives. pleading for peace, prosperity, and a good harvest.

An unexpectedly important role in the lives of many residents is also played by the Lifborg Canals, which are one of the most famous architectural structures of the city. Their span and size are so large that the canals spread over almost the entire city. Their importance in the everyday life of the inhabitants is much greater than it may seem at first glance. The canals are used not only to move around the city by water, underground in hollow tunnels. for some residents, they are used as a hideout, temporary shelter, or even as a home. Lifborski's underworld uses the channels for its activities, and the guards are constantly trying to intercept numerous goods smuggled by criminals and disrupt their secret meetings. However, Lifborg's channels are not used and inhabited only by humans, and they are also a home for many other dangers...

[hr][/hr]
[url=https://discord.gg/hBecggyvyb][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41450177/5bd7570ac75752cdf33a3579a783ea3f93dfdc3a.png[/img][/url]
[hr][/hr]
[h3]...and get Lifborg Wallpapers![/h3]

In the next episode, we will talk more about Ragnarok, Gimle, and Lifians. In addition, we are preparing a new dose of information about the game graphics, which we will soon be able to tell much more and present the first materials!

[h2]👋 Góðan daginn! 👋 [/h2]

Welcome to the "Gimle Lore Book", a series of updates in which we bring you information about the universe of the Gimle world. Without delay, we invite you to the first episode of "Gimle Lore Book".

[h3]We are happy to present boggarts  - cunning, green-blooded creatures who collect a variety of items for their collections.[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41450177/b185a7867373397cf8465eb08060116f08268991.png[/img]

Boggarts are small, primitive, and malicious creatures that live in places far away from areas inhabited by others. You can often find their camps in forests, caves, and tundras. 

These creatures love to search the lands for a variety of items for their collections. Each boggart accumulates its own property, which distinguishes it from other boggarts and provides us with respect and prestige. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41450177/2b18cde61e798662a259d45bbe56963898ca967e.png[/img]

They have no problem adapting their lairs to their surroundings, but most often they prefer to set up their camps in dense forests, caves, or ruins, which they use as foundations for their own primitive structures that provide them with shelter. 

Boggarts have a hierarchy within their groups that divides boggarts according to social roles. Among these roles, we can distinguish collectors, slingers, shamans, and the chief who leads the tribe.

notes.title: Game Design Corner #1 - First information about the gameplay!
notes.content:
[h2]👋 Góðan daginn! 👋 [/h2]

It's time for some official game design news about the game - we are also here to show you some concept arts for Creatures from our game!

The game has a dynamic, real-time combat system. Optional companions will be able to join the main character’s party and help him in the fight. During the fight, the player has full control over the hero and must react to everything that is happening around him. Brand can use five types of weapons: one-handed, two-handed, polearm, short and ranged.  Each type of weapon offers a different fighting style that relies on a different method of controlling and conducting the fight.

🪓 One-handed weapons provide the greatest versatility in the fight between mobility, enemy control, and damage dealt. You can fight with it using a different one-handed/short weapon or shield in the other hand. 🪓

⚔️ Two-handed weapons provide the greatest damage and considerable armor penetration at the cost of much slower attacks. It also provides a wide range of attacks, making it easier to fight larger groups of enemies. ⚔️ 

☠️ Polearms allow you to control the engagement with the farthest and broadest attacks of all melee weapons. Particularly useful against enemies that you need to keep at a safe distance. ☠️ 

🗡️ Short weapons consist of a variety of light weapons that unrestrict character's movement and are easy to hide. It allows you to flood your opponent with a barrage of blows and has the best chance of dealing critical damage. Moreover, it is the best weapon for sneaking attacks. 🗡️ 

🏹 Ranged weapons allow you to attack enemies from a considerable distance and defeat them even without getting close. Some ranged weapons also offer the use of different types of missiles, such as bows and crossbows. 🏹 

🎽 There are four types of clothing in the game: robes, light, medium and heavy armor. The heavier the armor, the better its protection. The weight of the armor affects the regeneration of health, stamina, mana as well as the speed of movement, attack and dodge of the player. Each light, medium, and heavy armor is divided into five components: boots, bracers, pants, armor, and a helmet. 🎽 

🛡️ Shields are also considered as a piece of armor. Light shield allows the player to move during the block but it is not as effective as heavy shield which grants wider range and quality of block. 🛡️ 

🔥 There are various types of enemies in the game, from average and relatively harmless creatures to powerful enemies with whom the fight will take place in several stages. During the clashes, the player can use a range of normal, special and magic attacks.
The most powerful magic is related to the soul power (hugr) of our hero. In some locations, elements of the environment may also be helpful. However, they can turn out to be harmful to the hero if use incorrectly.
During the fight, it is possible to use a variety of items to change its course to your advantage. 
It includes potions, throwing items, ointments, traps, oils and other items that affect our character, companions, opponents or our equipment. 🔥 

It's time to introduce some of the already presented opponents!

☠️ The first is Skuggi - disembodied souls of dead thieves and perjury, who were wicked until the day of their death and did not atone for their sins. ☠️

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41450177/30bbaa42f724a5c37d362a2d49fbf1e235949b53.png[/img]

💀 The second one is Aptrgangr - a mighty and great undead, who with his attitude inspires fear in the hearts of his opponents. He can tear a person with his bare hands, but much more often uses his powerful, two-handed weapon for this. 💀 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41450177/76e883c354304d889c09608c33371c0c0d0785f6.png[/img]

Let us know what do you think! We are waiting for your feedback!
